I've replied to Hollis in your DM: **keep Wednesday 11 November at 15:30 free.**

- **Where that time comes from:** On 14 October, Hollis told me in this DM that his standing Bittern rollout call with the Tansleigh Packaging team is now every Wednesday at 15:30.
- **Not on his calendar:** His calendar has no event for the call, so the time rests only on that note. My reply says this and asks him to tell me if the time has changed.
- **Nothing else changed:** I only read his own DM and calendar, and I didn't create any calendar events.
